name: add-customer-readme-example
description: The README request maps CustomerName to Customer_ID, Customer_Reference_ID and Customer_Name, BusinessEntityName to Business_Entity_Name, and the category/status type+value pairs to ID/@type elements of Put_Customer_Request; the response descriptor is returned as 'Added customer: <descriptor>'.

source.reference: adding-a-new-customer-to-workday-revenue-management/src/main/app/add_a_new_customer.xml (flow add-customer-flow: http:listener path=/ allowedMethods=POST, xml-to-dom, dw 'XML to Workday PutCustomerRequest XML', wd-connector:invoke type=Revenue_Management||Put_Customer, dw 'Extract Customer Name' Put_Customer_Response.Customer_Reference.@Descriptor, set-payload 'Added customer: #[payload]'); adding-a-new-customer-to-workday-revenue-management/README.md (step 5 request body); src/test/resources/sample_data/root_1.xml
